title: Q2
description:
“For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and goats could take away sins.”
Read: Lev 16:30, Psa 51:16–17
a) Lev 16 promised the people would be clean before Yahweh, yet the rite was repeated each year. David says, “You do not desire sacrifice.” What do these bring forward about the limits of animal blood?
